findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

REPEAT- The water dispenser heads of both coffee machines are observed to be in need of cleaning. Ensure that these are cleaned daily to be clean to sight and touch. CORRECTED- Both dispensers were cleaned during the inspection by the PIC.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

The following physical facilities were observed to be in need of repair: 

1. There are holes observed above the handwashing sink in the kitchen where the museum has removed an ice machine and it left two holes in the wall. Ensure that these holes are either repaired or filled and made to be smooth and easily cleanable. 
2. The left of the triple sink is observed to be coming off of the wall. Ensure that this is reattached and caulked to the wall and made to be smooth and easily cleanable. 

Ensure that physical facilities are repaired and are maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. 

The walk-in freezer floor is observed to be in need of cleaning. Ensure that it is cleaned and maintained cleaned by next routine inspection.
